posts.name: Orphanleni
posts.cooked:
I've been a D10 user since I got the game but I'm still on the lookout for a better way of doing things. I've used the pack in tokens and I'm not fond of them myself, just too messy on the table for me. I have the old school HP tracker cards but one bump of the table and there's no knowing where we were. Spiffs dial counters are nice but they're a little fragile even on card stock and laminated with packing tape.

 

Anyone have any other suggestions I haven't found? Maybe a sturdier Dial tracker that's card(ish) sized and thin enough to fit a few of them in my box with everything else?

 

I haven't found anything online that caught my eye and I'm hoping if there's no suggestions here that I can find something at PAXEast.

posts.name: Spiff
posts.cooked:
I'm glad people find my trackers so useful, but there is another good, cheap option.  You can use a knitting stitch counter like this:

http://us.deramores.com/milward-knitting-register-row-counters-large-small

They're small plastic cylinders with changeable numbers showing.  I found a pack of three at Michael's craft store for about $10, and they should be easy to find for cheap online too.

They'll be sturdier than mine, though it looks like they only count up to 50, and of course they look Magic-ey rather than Superhero-ey.  But maybe that's a solution for you.

posts.name: fba827
posts.cooked:
I saw a file on boardgamegeek.com (i'll have to look up the link later to give proper credit) that was basically a sheet of paper with circles for HP ranging from 40 to 0 (or something like that) as well as circular cut-outs for each hero.  And then you could track all heroes' hp on the one piece of paper by moving their token.

This also makes it really easy to see which hero has the highest/lowest hp at any given instant by referncing token placement on the one sheet.
